# Welcome to the Safer Parks Dashboard!

[This is a test version of the site ahead of launch to ensure the registration process works smoothly.]{.emphasis}

[Supporting safer, more inclusive parks for women and girls]{.emphasis}

[A free mapping tool that brings together open data and spatial insights to help practitioners understand the factors that shape safety and inclusion in parks across England and Wales.]{.emphasis3}

::::{.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .align-items-center}


:::::{.larger-bullets}
Use the dashboard to:

- Visualise park safety factors
- Explore spatial data layers
- Make decisions with evidence
- Create safer parks in your area
:::::

:::{.text-box2}
Grounded in the [*Safer Parks: Improving Access to Women and Girls* guidance](https://eprints.whiterose.ac.uk/id/eprint/229530/1/250908_Safer%20Parks_PCPI_Single.pdf), , the dashboard helps practitioners explore visibility, lighting, access points, route popularity, vegetation, park facilities and surrounding communities across parks in England and Wales.

**[**Launch the dashboard**](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=qO3qvR3IzkWGPlIypTW3y_21PdTtSidAqW-TSzvWOgxUNzlNSDBOWFBSN1JQM0YzUEhYUDdTOE5TNC4u) to get started, or visit the [**About**](about.qmd) and [**How to Use**](guide.qmd) pages to learn more.**
